ios.desc:
Speak your mind. Skip the typing.
airtxt turns your voice into clear, polished text in any app on your iPhone. Speak naturally—it removes ums and false starts, adds punctuation, and cleans up your wording. From quick replies to long emails, get the words you meant without typing them out.
Use the airtxt keyboard in Mail, Messages, Slack, Notes, WhatsApp, and wherever else you type. And when it’s time for a meeting, let airtxt take the notes and draft the follow-up.

LESS TYPING. MORE DONE.
• Answer emails between meetings.
• Keep up with the group chat when your hands are full.
• Turn a long “here’s what happened” into a message without thumb-typing.
• Capture a late-night idea before it disappears.
• Finish a call with notes, a summary, and a follow-up draft.

ONE VOICE KEYBOARD. EVERY APP.
Tap Speak on the airtxt keyboard, say what you want to write, then tap the checkmark. Your finished text appears right at your cursor—no switching apps or copying it over.

YOUR WORDS, CLEANED UP
Keep your meaning. Lose the stumbles. AI cleanup removes filler words, fixes wording, and adds punctuation. It adapts to where you’re writing: polished for email, relaxed for chat.

MEETING NOTES WITHOUT THE NOTE-TAKING
Send the airtxt bot into a Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams call. Get a transcript with speaker labels, a summary, and a drafted follow-up email. Stay in the conversation instead of scrambling to write everything down.

ON-DEVICE OR CLOUD. YOUR CHOICE.
Choose on-device transcription to turn speech into text on your iPhone. Your audio stays on your phone; the transcribed text is sent for AI cleanup.
Choose cloud transcription for noisy environments and support for more than 60 languages.

THE DETAILS THAT MAKE IT YOURS
• Personal dictionary: Add names, brands, and jargon so airtxt gets your words right.
• Quick memos: Say an idea and it’s saved and copied, ready to paste.
• Your own AI keys: Use your Deepgram, Anthropic, or OpenAI account. Your keys are stored in your iPhone’s Keychain.
• Easy shortcuts: Start with Siri or the Action Button.

START FREE
Get started for free with a weekly AI cleanup allowance.
Pro ($9.99/month or $99.99/year) adds cloud transcription and a monthly allowance of meeting hours. Pro+ ($19.99/month or $199.99/year) adds more meeting time.
Available on iPhone.
Questions or feedback? Contact hi@airtxt.ai.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
